name: Drawer
description: Edge sheet for secondary flows: slides from any side (sm/md/lg), with Dialog-grade modal semantics (portal, focus trap, Escape, focus restoration).
designIntent: Filters, detail panes, and mobile navigation need more room than a popover but shouldn't hijack the whole screen like a dialog. Drawer is an edge-anchored sheet with the SAME a11y contract as Dialog — portal, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape, focus restore — so swapping between them never regresses keyboard or screen-reader behavior.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Close requests (✕, Escape, backdrop, your own triggers).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible dialog name rendered as the header title.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line under the title (wired via aria-describedby).

props.name: size
props.description: Extent along the side axis (width for left/right, height for top/bottom).

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Clicking the backdrop closes the drawer.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Hide the header ✕ button (Escape and backdrop still close).

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Element focused on open (defaults to the first focusable element).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Overrides the accessible name (defaults to the title).

examples.title: Filter panel from the right
examples.code:
<Button onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(true)}>Filters</Button>
<Drawer
  open={filtersOpen}
  onOpenChange={setFiltersOpen}
  title="Filter results"
  description="Narrow by status and date"
  side="right"
  size="md"
>
  <FilterControls />
</Drawer>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a Drawer for a single decision
antiPatterns.explanation: One-question gates belong in Confirmation (alertdialog) — a whole sheet for approve/reject buries the decision.
antiPatterns.example:
// avoid: drawer around a yes/no
// prefer: <Confirmation title="Delete?" … />

antiPatterns.title: Don't stack sheets
antiPatterns.explanation: Two open drawers fight for focus and z-index. Close the first (or render one container) before opening another.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide critical actions in a closed drawer
antiPatterns.explanation: Drawers are secondary flows — the primary action must stay visible on the page.
antiPatterns.example: // filters live in the drawer; the Apply button on the page is fine

accessibility.implementation: role=dialog + aria-modal, labelled by title, described by description; portal to body
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass a title — it becomes both header text and accessible name

accessibility.implementation: Focus moves to the first focusable element on open, is trapped with Tab/Shift+Tab, and restores to the opener on close
Escape closes; backdrop click closes when closeOnBackdrop (default)
accessibility.userRequirements: Use showClose={false} only when the body owns an explicit close action

accessibility.implementation: Body region scrolls internally (overflow-y-auto) — the page behind never scrolls

compositionRules.relationship: The trigger that opens the drawer (aria-haspopup optional)
Drawers commonly host forms — spacing and wiring come from the form family
Dialog for centered modal decisions; Drawer for edge-anchored secondary flows
